selection.rule: First two chronological manufacturer-1 reports with problem 'no heat' or 'not enough heat', outside substations 21, 4, 7, 12, and 24 and on distinct substations, having >=100 prior-24-hour samples and nonempty required hc1 fields; reports 37 and 5 selected before cycle-3 inference.
selection.cutoff: measurement timestamp <= report date; prior records strictly earlier

fault_label: Failure of the heating circuit pump
note: Published report fields are retrospective; they are not a real-time ground truth at the decision time.
